newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 20.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- National Assembly adopts bill strengthening control of immigration.

-- Dassault and Aerospatiale agree industrial aspects of their merger and talks continue with the government on legal and financial aspects. Dassault-Aviation to be 100 percent-controlled by a new group, Dassault-Aerospatiale, and make fighter planes and executive jets. Former Aerospatiale divisions become branches in passenger aircraft, space, defence and missiles activities.
-- Rhone-Poulenc to reshuffle activity, seeks to improve pharmaceutical division's profitability while concentrating on core chemistry business.
-- Dutch banking group ABN-Amro interested in buying Banque Demachy Worms, specialised in private banking, and Banque Phenix.
